notes.title: The Restful, The Cheery, and The Unfazed [Found Footages]
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Kind Spirits![/h1]

Living in this big and dark mansion is not easy. The never-ending hallways, the thumps occasionally heard outside the room, and the lack of lights which make it hard to see what's on the front.
In usual life, people come and go. But here, no one ever go, they died and became part of the mansion instead. The thought of escaping the mansion looks more futile as days go.

Sightings found that the mansion got more victims recently, and by more, we meant a whole lot more. Most of them seem to have survived and got out, and the others who failed are trapped inside for eternity.

We came across found footages of people who dared to venture in the mansion. They were lured in because they think they were ready, they think they have seen the mansion before and would be okay. Well, we hope they were right.

All found footages might contain spoilers, while every experiences is different for each person, it is better to not see any spoiler for the full experience.

[h2]The first one is Apollo[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33816142/b386d85fb9ad7b9a3a0ebc986f3a3907c840ffac.jpg[/img]
[h3]Found footage:[/h3] https://youtu.be/HwCilDTU38g
Apollo, an explorer that have traveled on many kind of scary and creepy places. He has outsmarted some beings outside of this planet, killed lot of virus-infected people, and even destroyed beings from memories.
He cut his adventure in parts, take some rest, and in the meantime doing some other venturing in other places on his resting time. He already went to the Witch's House and definitely trying to be more careful here, it's really fun to see them wondering around and commenting on lot of things. He explored about a half of the mansion, and pretty sure would be able to get out sooner or later. We hope he'll keep going through.

[h2]The second one is Zezuu[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33816142/67a10f5546f12b6521502037607e39dcecc74aa9.jpg[/img]
[h3]Found footage:[/h3] https://youtu.be/cOLtbioePcg
Zezuu, a veteran, he has been journeying far and wide for about 9 years, from a place where you can destroy a planet with energy stored inside your body to magical place where you have to exile other people to achieve prizes.
This found footage is an old one, but we hope he will come back. Because, when he is back, there definitely will be more surprises for him here and there. His commentary is easy to enjoy, and hopefully he was enjoying himself too. The footage is not too long, but not too short, it's just right. Sadly, he left his exploration right after the death door.
In our retrospect that ghost definitely is a pesky one, and we've driven them out from there (they were very angry). Hopefully, Zezuu will be back for more exploring.

[h2]The third one is FluffeyPanda[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33816142/c1035d0bb03449fb8b49934a3ef3ed2e2497aed7.jpg[/img]
[h3]Found footage:[/h3] https://youtu.be/K7wpvcA3ppA
A humble and genuine guy who just want to have fun exploring places, especially if the place was discovered by smaller team. He does lot of commentary and even trying to complete lot of his adventures, definitely someone you should look out.
He seems very calm throughout the footage, one that is not easily fazed. We knew this is not his first journey to places of horror, but we didn't know someone will be this undisturbed. We just hope he's enjoying himself behind his calm demeanor. The footage stopped where he was stuck inside the dream, he then promptly told us to help him. Even though the mansion was still below what he considers as satisfying experience, we hope he'll come back when he can achieve the true ending. (which he said in the found footage.)

We're really glad that there are people who dared to challenge the mansion to escape from here. And we know, these are just 3 from who knows how many more the mansion lured in. If any of you have found footages we need to see, please tell us!

Thank you for taking your time to check them out, and see you for more found footages of people challenging the mansion.
Stay tune!

------------------------------

notes.title: FOUND FOOTAGE OF PEOPLE SURVIVING INSIDE THE MANSION
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Kind Spirits![/h1]

Living in this big and dark mansion is not easy. The never-ending hallways, the thumps occasionally heard outside the room, and the lack of lights which make it hard to see what's on the front.
In usual life, people come and go. But here, no one ever go, they died and became part of the mansion instead. The thought of escaping the mansion looks more futile as days go.

Sightings found that the mansion got more victims recently, and by more, we meant a whole lot more. Most of them seem to have survived and got out, and the others who failed are trapped inside for eternity.

We came across found footages of people who dared to venture in the mansion. The 3 of them entered the mansion at the same time, and while 2 of them got out, the last one is still struggling to survive inside.

All found footages might contain spoilers, while every experiences is different for each person, it is better to not see any spoiler for the full experience.

[h2]The first one is Biyori[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33816142/40ddcd683e170d61e0fb319a17bd04203ca0c804.jpg[/img]
[h3]Found footage:[/h3] https://youtu.be/N0FDxOgFMdg
A singer who could be seen venturing out in the wilds or even the space when he is not singing. Seems like he could be a good bard.
He survived the mansion's ordeal and even defeated the bloody footsteps with only a sliver of energy left, quite an impressive feat we might add. His commentary and his experience on the footage helped us a lot for the improvement around the mansion. Although he didn't really get outside, he still pulled through to the end. Hopefully, he will come back for more exploring.
Check him out for his songs cover, he's really great at it.

[h2]The second one is Kynara[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33816142/d1f4ae5d9bde56e33d87e9b0175c9db735d59743.jpg[/img]
[h3]Found footage:[/h3] https://youtu.be/3CJ59upPXQ8
An adventurer who ventured to lot of places, mostly to places where he could shoot some kind of weapons. Too bad there is no weapon he could shoot in here, it would have been easier for all of us.
He uses mostly local languages, but his commentary is fun to be followed if you understand. His adventures inside the mansion was very rough, he kept going back to his diary a lot, but he still had quite lot of energy when he confronted the bloody footsteps. While he entered at the same time as Biyori, he held out until he could actually escape the mansion. He escaped, only to realize something is not right. Hopefully, he will come back, to fix what happened to him.
Check him out if you are interested about shooting and looting.

[h2]The third one is Ryoki[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33816142/f08d5a7cbd9a3174db3c97cae7efd2efd411c1e2.jpg[/img]
[h3]Found footage:[/h3] https://youtu.be/yRfmjIBIfsU
A vampire who really loves being an adventurer, killing dragons, and hanging out in a tavern to play cards. Even though she's a vampire, she's not good with horror even though it's not her first time, it's fun to see her reactions though.
Her journey hasn't seen an end yet, but we know she'll definitely escape successfully, because she really doesn't want to be here. Her commentary revolved around the obvious, which led to fun reaction. Although, if it's really that obvious, none of us would be stuck here for eternity now, wouldn't we? She already met Amber, and halfway on helping her for the ritual, so the next found footage should have her escape the mansion safely, hopefully.
Check her out if you are interested in adventuring to fight dragons.

We're really glad that there are people who dared to challenge the mansion to escape from here. And we know, these are just 3 from who knows how many more the mansion lured in. If any of you have found footages we need to see, tell us!

Thank you for taking your time to check them out, and see you for more found footages of people challenging the mansion.
Stay tune!

notes.title: Updates on the Development Progress
notes.content:
[h3]A candle to not leave you in the dark[/h3]

We've been redeveloping Cursed Mansion for almost a year now.​ From what was started as an idea to contribute to the horror RPG fanbase and was a part of Square Enix Collective, now a game that would be a foundation for our dev team.

On the last September, we had the opportunity to revisit Cursed Mansion, we've learned a lot since then. With each new knowledge, we improved parts of the game accordingly. Now, the game is, in our opinion, a lot better than what we first imagined, and there are still things we want to improve.

With that in mind, and what's currently happening around us, we came to a hard decision to delay our game. [b]The plan to release the game on October this year is postponed to around the end of December to the start of January.[/b] Of course we will also update the demo later on, with new mechanics and features that would become apparent if you play it and you watch others play it.

[b]We will of course update you on the progress and sneak peek[/b].

It was a tough decision, but felt needed. Thank you for your patience, and please stay tune for the next update!


P.S.: The demo will still be available to play if you want to have a feel before the update later on.
